title: Move Git remote and Pages rows out of gh/mod.rs into submodules
summary: Structure-pass job G3: move Remote trait, GitRemote and helpers into gh/remote.rs, and the Pages items (PAGES_WORKFLOW, PagesRun, PagesHost and its GhClient impl, PagesReport, wait constants, wait_pages_run, watch_pages) into gh/pages.rs. Text is moved verbatim, gh/mod.rs re-exports so public paths are unchanged, and a CHANGELOG entry is added. The audience is the verifier checking the section 5 proof.

defaults_applied.how: verifier greps and compares test lists
test-list comparison and grep of callers
n/a pure move; re-exports keep paths
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job G1 has landed so crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs exists.
Visibility of moved private items may widen to pub(super)/pub(crate) only as needed for the split.
Docs still citing gh.rs are left to a later job (G1 verification noted this; section 5 rule 7).

acceptance_criteria.text: gh/remote.rs holds the Remote trait, GitRemote, its impl and helpers used only by them; gh/pages.rs holds PAGES_WORKFLOW, PagesRun, PagesHost, the GhClient impl of PagesHost, PagesReport, the PAGES_* wait constants, wait_pages_run and watch_pages. Moved text is identical to the old text apart from visibility and import lines (git diff shows moved blocks unchanged).

gh/mod.rs declares the remote and pages modules and re-exports every previously public name with pub use, so gh::Remote, gh::GitRemote, gh::PagesHost, gh::PagesReport, gh::watch_pages and other public paths are unchanged.
Existing tests, including after_a_merge_the_branch_is_resynced_then_pages_watched_then_code_health_checked, are edited only on import lines; no test is added, removed or renamed.

No file outside crates/athena-core/src/gh/ names a moved item by an old module path (gh::remote::... or gh::pages::... would be new internal paths only); the verifier confirms with a Grep over crates/ for those paths and for moved names, finding every caller still uses the gh:: re-export.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the G3 move stating behavior is unchanged.
Run cargo test --locked -- --list before (git stash-free: compare against the base via git show/diff of test names) and after; the lists of test names are identical.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked; all three pass.

out_of_scope: Moving other gh rows (other G jobs)
